<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FindAJob"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Application confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProbationComplete" name="Probation completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PermanentOutcome" name="Job becomes permanent"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_NonPermanentOutcome" name="Job does not become permanent"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies" processRef="Process_Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Job application" messageRef="Message_Application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Start_ApplicationReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Application confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProbationComplete" name="Probation completed" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Permanent" name="Permanent outcome" messageRef="Message_PermanentOutcome" sourceRef="Task_SendPermanentOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReceivePermanentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NonPermanent" name="Non-permanent outcome" messageRef="Message_NonPermanentOutcome" sourceRef="Task_SendNonPermanentOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReceiveNonPermanentOutcome"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Job applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_JobSearch" name="Start job search"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit job application" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive application confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewSplit" name="Negotiate an interview?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview choice"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterProbation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" name="Notify company that probation is complete" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating" name="Continue rating and outcome paths"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OneYear" name="One year passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewVisible" name="Company review becomes visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForJobOutcome" name="Wait for job outcome"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePermanentOutcome" name="Receive permanent-job outcome" messageRef="Message_PermanentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveNonPermanentOutcome" name="Receive non-permanent-job outcome" messageRef="Message_NonPermanentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRating" name="Rated company C or lower?" default="Flow_RatingAboveC"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PermanentJob" name="Permanent job; no further offers"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NonPermanentJob" name="Job does not become permanent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_JobSearch" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewYes" name="Interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Interview is negotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewNo" name="No interview negotiation" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewToMerge" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Task_EnterProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_EnterProbation" targetRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating" targetRef="Event_OneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Event_OneYear" targetRef="End_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForJobOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForJobOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReceivePermanentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForJobOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReceiveNonPermanentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePermanentOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCOrLower" name="C or lower" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Company rating is C or lower</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" name="Above C" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="End_PermanentJob"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A16" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveNonPermanentOutcome" targetRef="End_NonPermanentJob"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Companies" name="Company application and employment workflow" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDefinition_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm receipt of application" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplication" name="Rate application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WantsApplicant" name="Company wants applicant to work for it?" default="Flow_NoOffer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoOffer" name="No job offer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" name="Receive probation completion" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate job applicant"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobPermanent" name="Does the job become permanent?" default="Flow_NotPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPermanentOutcome" name="Send permanent-job outcome" messageRef="Message_PermanentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNonPermanentOutcome" name="Send non-permanent-job outcome" messageRef="Message_NonPermanentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PermanentOutcomeSent" name="Permanent outcome sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NonPermanentOutcomeSent" name="Non-permanent outcome sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_RateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferWanted" name="Company wants applicant" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="Task_SendOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Company wants applicant to work for it</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoOffer" name="Otherwise" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="End_NoOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Permanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendPermanentOutcome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Job becomes permanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPermanent" name="Otherwise" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendNonPermanentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Task_SendPermanentOutcome" targetRef="End_PermanentOutcomeSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="Task_SendNonPermanentOutcome" targetRef="End_NonPermanentOutcomeSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FindAJob"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Application receipt confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProbationComplete" name="Probation phase completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmploymentOutcome" name="Employment outcome"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies" processRef="Process_Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Job application" messageRef="Message_Application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Start_ApplicationReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Application receipt confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer_Reporting" name="Potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_Reporting"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer_NoReporting" name="Potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_NoReporting"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProbationComplete" name="Probation phase completed" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmploymentOutcome" name="Employment outcome" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome" sourceRef="Task_SendEmploymentOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Job applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_JobSearch" name="Start job search"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit job application" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive application receipt confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Report companies applied to regularly"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer_Reporting" name="Receive potential job offer while reporting" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer_NoReporting" name="Receive potential job offer without reporting" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeOfferReceipts" name="Continue with received offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewSplit" name="Negotiate a job interview?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview choice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterProbation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" name="Notify company that probation is complete" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AfterRating_Split" name="Continue rating visibility and employment outcome paths"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OneYear" name="One year passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewVisible" name="Company review becomes visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome" name="Receive employment outcome" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobPermanent" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRating" name="Rated the company C or less?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingStatus" name="Has the reporting obligation ended?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PermanentJob" name="Permanent job; process ends"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_JobSearch" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_Reporting"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_Reporting" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOfferReceipts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_NoReporting" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOfferReceipts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeOfferReceipts" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewYes" name="Interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A job interview is negotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewNo" name="No interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewToMerge" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_EnterProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Task_EnterProbation" targetRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_AfterRating_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterRating_Split" targetRef="Event_OneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Event_OneYear" targetRef="End_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterRating_Split" targetRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRating">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The job becomes permanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobNotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCLess" name="C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_NoReporting">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The company rating is C or less</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" name="Above C" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="End_PermanentJob"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportingEnded" name="Reporting obligation has ended" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingStatus" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_NoReporting">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A previous permanent job ended reporting because the company rating was C or less</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportingContinues" name="Reporting obligation continues" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingStatus" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Companies" name="Company application and employment workflow" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDefinition_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm receipt of application" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplication" name="Rate job application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WantsApplicant" name="Does the company want the applicant to work for it?" default="Flow_NoOffer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoOffer" name="No job offer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" name="Receive probation completion" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate job applicant"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" name="Does the job become permanent?" default="Flow_NotPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmploymentOutcome" name="Send employment outcome" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmploymentOutcomeSent" name="Employment outcome sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_RateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferWanted" name="Company wants applicant to work for it" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="Task_SendOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The company wants the applicant to work for it</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoOffer" name="Otherwise" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="End_NoOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Permanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendEmploymentOutcome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The job becomes permanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendEmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Task_SendEmploymentOutcome" targetRef="End_EmploymentOutcomeSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewYes" name="Interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewIsNegotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewNo" name="No interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewToMerge" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_EnterProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_EnterProbation" targetRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_RatingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingSplit" targetRef="Event_OneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Event_OneYear" targetRef="End_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRating">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobNotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCLess" name="C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingIsCOrLess</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" name="Above C" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="End_PermanentJob"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Companies" name="Company application and employment workflow" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDefinition_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm receipt of application" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplication" name="Rate job application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WantsApplicant" name="Does the company want the applicant to work for it?" default="Flow_NoOffer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoOffer" name="Company does not want the applicant to work for it"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" name="Receive probation phase completion" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate job applicant"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" name="Does the job become permanent?" default="Flow_NotPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmploymentOutcome" name="Send employment outcome" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmploymentOutcomeSent" name="Employment outcome sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_RateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferWanted" name="Company wants applicant to work for it" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="Task_SendOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoOffer" name="Company does not want the applicant" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="End_NoOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendEmploymentOutcome"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FindAJob"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Application receipt confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProbationComplete" name="Probation phase completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmploymentOutcome" name="Employment outcome"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies" processRef="Process_Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Job application" messageRef="Message_Application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Start_ApplicationReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Application receipt confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_JobOffer" name="Potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProbationComplete" name="Probation phase completed" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmploymentPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome" sourceRef="Task_SendPermanentOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmploymentNotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome" sourceRef="Task_SendNotPermanentOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Job applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_JobSearch" name="Start job search"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit job application" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive application receipt confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewChoice" name="Negotiate a job interview?" default="Flow_InterviewNo"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview choice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterProbation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" name="Notify company that probation is complete" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating" name="Continue with review visibility and employment outcome"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OneYear" name="One year passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewVisible" name="Company review becomes visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome" name="Receive employment outcome" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobPermanent" name="Did the job become permanent?" default="Flow_JobNotPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRating" name="Did you rate the company C or less?" default="Flow_RatingAboveC"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PermanentJob" name="Permanent job; process ends"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_JobSearch" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewYes" name="Interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewChoice" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewIsNegotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewNo" name="No interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewChoice" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewToMerge" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_EnterProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_EnterProbation" targetRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating" targetRef="Event_OneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Event_OneYear" targetRef="End_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRating">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobNotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCLess" name="C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingIsCOrLess</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" name="Above C" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="End_PermanentJob"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Companies" name="Company application and employment workflow" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDefinition_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm receipt of application" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplication" name="Rate job application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WantsApplicant" name="Does the company want the applicant to work for it?" default="Flow_NoOffer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoOffer" name="Company does not want the applicant to work for it"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" name="Receive probation phase completion" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate job applicant"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" name="Does the job become permanent?" default="Flow_NotPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPermanentOutcome" name="Notify applicant that the job becomes permanent" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotPermanentOutcome" name="Notify applicant that the job does not become permanent" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PermanentOutcomeSent" name="Permanent employment outcome sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotPermanentOutcomeSent" name="Non-permanent employment outcome sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_RateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferWanted" name="Company wants the applicant to work for it" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="Task_SendOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoOffer" name="Company does not want the applicant" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="End_NoOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Permanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendPermanentOutcome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendNotPermanentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Task_SendPermanentOutcome" targetRef="End_PermanentOutcomeSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="Task_SendNotPermanentOutcome" targetRef="End_NotPermanentOutcomeSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
